description: NaPO₃ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with five PO₄ tetrahedra, edges with four NaO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.61 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with five PO₄ tetrahedra, edges with four NaO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.46 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six PO₄ tetrahedra and edges with six NaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.39 Å. There are three inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with six NaO₆ octahedra and corners with two PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 42-69°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.48-1.61 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with six NaO₆ octahedra and corners with two PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 39-69°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.48-1.61 Å. In the third P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two PO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 8-62°. There are two shorter (1.48 Å) and two longer (1.61 Å) P-O bond lengths. There are nine inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to two P atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two P atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two P atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one P atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one P atom.
